QuestInfo.name: [Lethe] Idol of the Forest
QuestInfo.0: Haezel wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Haezel wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.2: Another rumor took you to Leafre, where you found...superfans of yourself? Apparently your vassals Lancer and Slayer had come to Leafre in search of dragons, but ended up drafting the locals into creating a temple in Lethe's honor. They'd hoped you'd move to stay in this peaceful place, but you explained that you'd had your fill of peace from your long sleep. They tried to resist, but you once again brought them under control.
